text_en: Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion! Put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city; for the uncircumcised and the unclean shall enter you no more.
text_cn: 熙雍起来，起来！披上你的威能！耶路撒冷圣城！穿上你华丽的衣服，因为未受割损和不洁的人，再不得进入你内。

text_en: Shake yourself from the dust, rise up, O captive Jerusalem; loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter Zion!
text_cn: 被掳的耶路撒冷！抖下灰尘，起来吧！被俘的熙雍女子！解下你颈项上的锁链吧！

text_en: For thus says the Lord : You were sold for nothing, and you shall be redeemed without money.
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：“你们是无代价被出卖的，也无需用金钱赎回。”

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Long ago, my people went down into Egypt to reside there as aliens; the Assyrian, too, has oppressed them without cause.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“我的百姓昔日曾下到埃及，侨居在那里，而后亚述又无故地虐待了她；

text_en: Now therefore what am I doing here, says the Lord , seeing that my people are taken away without cause? Their rulers howl, says the Lord , and continually, all day long, my name is despised.
text_cn: 如今我还在这里作什么？上主的断语。我的百姓已无故地被掳去，治理他的人又自夸自大──上主的断语──我的名又天天不断地受亵渎。

text_en: Therefore my people shall know my name; therefore in that day they shall know that it is I who speak; here am I.
text_cn: 为此我的百姓必要认得我的名，到那一天他们必明白：那说：‘看！我在这里！’的那一位，就是我。”

text_en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns. ”
text_cn: 那传布喜讯，宣布和平，传报佳音，宣布救恩，给熙雍说“你的天主为王了！”的脚步，在山上是多么美丽啊！

text_en: Listen! Your sentinels lift up their voices, together they sing for joy; for in plain sight they see the return of the Lord to Zion.
text_cn: 请听，你的守望者都提高了喉咙，一起欢呼，因为他们亲眼看见上主返回了熙雍。

text_en: Break forth together into singing, you ruins of Jerusalem; for the Lord has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷的废墟啊！你们要兴高采烈，一起欢呼，因为上主安慰了自己的百姓，救赎了耶路撒冷。

text_en: The Lord has bared his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
text_cn: 上主在万民眼前显露了自己的圣臂，大地四极看见了我们天主的救恩。

text_en: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; go out from the midst of it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the Lord .
text_cn: 离开！离开！从那里出来吧！不要触摸不洁之物！你们携带上主器皿的人，从巴比伦中间出来，圣洁自己吧！

text_en: For you shall not go out in haste, and you shall not go in flight; for the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
text_cn: 你们出走，不必慌张，更不必奔逃而去， 因为上主要走在你们前面，以色列的天主将作你们的后盾。

text_en: See, my servant shall prosper; he shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.
text_cn: 请看，我的仆人必要成功，必要受尊荣，必要被举扬，且极受崇奉。

text_en: Just as there were many who were astonished at him —so marred was his appearance, beyond human semblance, and his form beyond that of mortals—
text_cn: 就如许多人对他不胜惊愕，因为他的容貌损伤得已不像人，他的形状已不像人子；

text_en: so he shall startle many nations; kings shall shut their mouths because of him; for that which had not been told them they shall see, and that which they had not heard they shall contemplate.
text_cn: 同样众民族也都要对他不胜惊异，众君王在他面前都要闭口，因为他们看见了从未向他们讲述过的事，听见了从未听说过的事。
